_readme: Deeplink-resolution benchmark: SIIS-style instructions -> expected catalog entry. Covers the four PDF domains (Display, Battery, Performance, Camera) plus Connectivity, and every trap found in the catalog audit. expect = DL id, 'DUMMY' (Settings screen with no catalog entry) or null (not a Settings screen). tags mark polarity / trap / message-trap cases. Expected ids were verified against data/deeplinks.json by hand.

cases.text: Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Navigation bar.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to turn it on.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to disable it.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Screen timeout.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then turn on Eye comfort shield.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then turn off Adaptive brightness.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Screen mode.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Motion smoothness.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Auto rotate.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Screen zoom.
Go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Font size and style.
Go to Settings, tap Lock screen, and then tap Always On Display to turn it off.
Go to Settings, tap Accessibility, tap Visibility enhancements, and then turn on Extra dim.
Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap Power saving to turn it on.
Go to Settings, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, and then turn on Put unused apps to sleep.
Go to Settings, tap Battery, tap More battery settings, and then turn off Fast charging.
Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap Battery protection.
Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then turn on Adaptive battery.

Go to Settings, tap Device care, and then tap Restart on schedule.
Press and hold the Power button, and then tap Restart.

Go to Settings, tap Accessibility, tap Advanced settings, and then turn on Camera flash notification.
Go to Settings, tap Sounds and vibration, and then turn off Camera feedback.
Go to Settings, tap Connections, and then tap Wi-Fi.

Go to Settings, tap Connections, and then tap Bluetooth.
Go to Settings, tap Connections, and then turn on Airplane mode.

Go to Settings, tap Notifications, and then tap App notifications.
